description: Unit tests for the OpenConnection class, which is part of the connectivity command modifications in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The file contains test cases verifying object equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path retrieval related to OpenConnection instances.

classes.name: OpenConnectionTest
classes.description: Test suite for the OpenConnection class, covering equality, immutability, JSON serialization, and path retrieval.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode implementations of OpenConnection.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks if OpenConnection instances are immutable and that ConnectionId is also immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as ConnectionId throws a NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that fromJson correctly reconstructs an OpenConnection instance from JSON.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that toJson serializes OpenConnection to the expected JSON format.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getResourcePath returns the expected JsonPointer.
